pages.title: Harvest Table – Fine Dining Restaurant
pages.html:
🍽️ Harvest Table

Harvest Table

Farm-to-table fine dining celebrating seasonal flavors and local craftsmanship

Reserve Your Table

Our Story

At Harvest Table, we believe that exceptional food begins with exceptional ingredients. Our head chef, Marcus Wellington, works directly with local farmers and producers across the Willamette Valley to source the finest seasonal ingredients. Every dish on our menu tells a story of the land, the season, and our commitment to culinary excellence.

Our intimate dining room seats only 45 guests, ensuring that every experience is personal, attentive, and unforgettable. We pride ourselves on our carefully curated wine list, featuring Oregon's most distinguished vintners and small-batch producers from around the world.

Featured Menu

This season, we celebrate autumn's bounty with dishes that showcase the region's finest produce and proteins.

Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Tart

Starter

Heirloom beets from Sunridge Farm with whipped local goat cheese, crispy pastry, and arugula oil. Pairs beautifully with our Pinot Gris.

$18

Pan-Seared Halibut

Main Course

Wild-caught Pacific halibut with golden corn velouté, charred baby leeks, and brown butter sauce. Finished with fresh dill from our garden.

$38

Grass-Fed Beef Tenderloin

Main Course

Heritage breed beef from Meadowbrook Ranch, perfectly seared and served with roasted root vegetables, mushroom ragù, and red wine reduction.

$45

Butternut Squash Risotto

Vegetarian Main

Creamy Arborio rice with roasted butternut squash, crispy sage, toasted pumpkin seeds, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

$28

Chocolate Torte

Dessert

Dense dark chocolate torte with espresso cream, fresh berries, and gold leaf. Served with a quenelle of vanilla bean ice cream.

$12

Seasonal Fruit Tart

Dessert

Buttery tart shell filled with crème pâtissière and topped with locally-grown heirloom apples, berries, and a light apricot glaze.

$11

Reserve Your Table

We welcome reservations for parties of 1 to 8 guests. For larger groups, please call us directly at (503) 555-0147.

Harvest Table Restaurant
